The next morning, Niki called off her photo-shoot.
lines.zh: 第二天早上,Niki 取消了她的摄影行程。

lines.en: The reason she gave to her manager and producers was, of course, something along the lines of just “not feeling well” since a breakup would likely be in violation of her contract.
lines.zh: 她给经纪人和制作方给的理由,当然不外乎「身体不适」之类——毕竟分手的消息一旦曝光,多半会违反她的合同。

lines.en: So it’s rescheduled to next weekend instead now. And it’ll be the last calendar shoot she does before making an announcement that her career is coming to an end.
lines.zh: 于是行程被改到下周末。那将是她最后一组日历写真,之后她就会宣布:她的职业生涯即将结束。

lines.en: “Graduating” I think they call it in the idol world. So hey, at least someone gets to since it’s not like any of the other girls I know will be doing that any time soon.
lines.zh: 「毕业」,偶像圈好像是这么叫的。嘿,至少有人能毕业了——反正我认识的其他女孩,短时间内是没这个机会的。

lines.en: Ami and Noriko don’t know yet. In fact, I don’t think Noriko’s exchanged a single word with her sister since she walked in on us last night.
lines.zh: Ami 和 Noriko 还不知道。事实上,我想从昨晚她撞见我们那一刻起,Noriko 就没和姐姐说过一句话。

lines.en: scene amiridehome1
Which is probably why the ride back to town is so awkward. And why I’d probably jump out of this moving car right now if it weren’t for the fact that it would further traumatize Ami.
lines.zh: : 这大概就是回城这一路如此尴尬的原因。也是为什么,要不是怕进一步创伤 Ami,我现在就会跳下这辆行驶中的车。

lines.en: At least she’s in a good mood.
lines.zh: : 至少她心情不错。

lines.en: Though, I can’t imagine she will be for long as I fully intend to ruin that by pulling her aside once we’re home and asking her why she’d orchestrate such a dramatic takedown of a girl I thought she loved.
lines.zh: : 虽然我无法想象能维持多久——因为我完全打算到家后把她拉到一边,问问她为什么要策划那样一场对我以为她深爱的女孩的戏剧性打击。

lines.en: I imagine she’ll tell me it was for my sake. Or that she wasn’t trying to search for us last night — she just couldn’t come up with an excuse to stop Niki from doing it.
lines.zh: : 我猜她会说这是为我好。或者说她昨晚根本没想找我们——只是想不出阻止 Niki 的借口。

lines.en: Whatever the case, I’m mad at her in addition to myself for playing some sort of role in this.
lines.zh: : 无论如何,除了我自己,我还恨她在这件事里扮演了某种角色。

lines.en: And, you know what? Fuck it. I’m mad at Niki too because she won’t even look at me today. Which is entirely fair and I wouldn’t look at me either, but I’m still mad.
lines.zh: : 而且,你猜怎么着?去他的。我也恨 Niki,因为她今天连看都不看我一眼。这完全公平,换成我也不会看我自己,但我还是恨。

lines.en: She could at least have the courtesy to tell me to fuck off or something. But instead, the only one here I’m not mad at is Noriko because she didn’t do anything wrong.
lines.zh: : 她至少可以客气一点,叫我滚远点什么的。可现在,这里唯一让我不恨的,反而是 Noriko——因为她没做错任何事。

lines.en: I just also feel terrible for dragging her into this mess. But I’m sure if you asked her, she wouldn’t tell you she regrets it. Just that she regrets getting caught.
lines.zh: : 我只是也觉得把可怜的她拖进这摊烂事,实在糟透了。但我敢肯定,你要是去问她,她绝不会说她后悔。只会说她后悔被抓到。

lines.en: So...like me. Just not nearly as bad for obvious reasons.
lines.zh: : 所以……和我一样。只是出于显而易见的原因,没我烂得那么彻底。

lines.en: scene amiridehome2
: So! How about we play a game to make this ride a little less quiet and a lot more fun? Anyone up for Shiritori? I’ll go first! Maguro!
lines.zh: : 那么!我们玩个游戏,让这一路别那么安静、有趣一点怎么样?有人想玩接龙吗?我先来!Maguro(金枪鱼)!

lines.en: : Ami-
lines.zh: : Ami——

lines.en: scene amiridehome3
: Bzzzzzt! You needed to come up with a word that started with “ro,” Dad! Now, you’ve already been eliminated and it’s just us girls left.
lines.zh: : 嘀——!爸爸,你得接一个「ro」开头的词!现在你已经被淘汰了,只剩我们女孩了。

lines.en: : No, Ami. I just don’t think anyone wants to play Shiri-
lines.zh: : 不,Ami。我只是觉得没人想玩接——

lines.en: : Romaji.
lines.zh: : Romaji(罗马字)。

lines.en: scene amiridehome4
: Jitensha!
lines.zh: : Jitensha(自行车)!

lines.en: : Okay. Fuck me, I guess.
lines.zh: : 好。看来我是完蛋了。

lines.en: scene amiridehome5
: Again? But you guys went at it for so long last night.
lines.zh: : 又做?可你们昨晚不是做了好久。

lines.en: : Oh, cool. Ami broke the pattern so I win.
lines.zh: : 哦,太好了。Ami 破坏了规律,所以我赢了。

lines.en: scene amiridehome6
: Ah, crap.
lines.zh: : 啊,糟了。

lines.en: : Way to go, Dad. She beats me in love. She beats me in boobs. And now she beats me in Shiritori. I have literally nothing left.
lines.zh: : 干得漂亮,爸爸。爱情上她赢我。胸上她赢我。现在接龙她也赢我。我真的是一无所有了。

lines.en: : We can play again if you want. Beats sitting in awkward silence.
lines.zh: : 你想的话我们可以再玩。总比尴尬地坐着强。

lines.en: scene amiridehome7
: Mame.
lines.zh: : Mame(豆子)。

lines.en: : Megami.
lines.zh: : Megami(女神)。

lines.en: : Minato.
lines.zh: : Minato(港)。

lines.en: : Tomato.
lines.zh: : Tomato(番茄)。

lines.en: : Toma-
lines.zh: : Toma——

lines.en: scene amiridehome8
: Crap!
lines.zh: : 糟了!

lines.en: : I think you just suck at this game, Ami. Want to play something else instead?
lines.zh: : 我觉得你只是玩不转这个游戏,Ami。要不要换个别的玩?

lines.en: scene amiridehome9
: Sure! What do you have in mind?
lines.zh: : 好呀!你有什么想法?

lines.en: : Hmm...let’s see...let’s see...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我想想……我想想……

lines.en: scene black
: Oh! I brought Karuta! Nii-chan, can you slide over? I need to get my bag.
lines.zh: : 哦!我带了歌牌!Nii-chan,能挪一挪吗?我得拿我的包。

lines.en: : Karuta? I haven’t played that in forever. I’m not even sure I remember how.
lines.zh: : 歌牌?我好多年没玩了。我都不确定还记得怎么玩。

lines.en: : Nee-chan taught me, so I will pass down the mystic art to you! Onii-chan, do you want to-
lines.zh: : 是姐教我的,所以我会把这门神秘技艺传给你!Onii-chan,你要不要——

lines.en: : But you two have fun...
lines.zh: : 但你们俩玩得开心……

lines.en: scene amiridehome10
After what can only be described as the longest drive of my life, we make it back to the house and Niki-
lines.zh: : 在堪称我人生最漫长的一段车程之后,我们终于回到家里,而 Niki——

lines.en: : I’m taking the bed. Don’t come in.
lines.zh: : 我睡床。别进来。

lines.en: scene amiridehome11
...Avoids me, as expected.
lines.zh: ……果然,躲着我。

lines.en: That’s fine, though. I can sleep on the couch instead. And besides, it’s not like I got even a minute of sleep last night, so anywhere is fine right now.
lines.zh: : 不过没关系。我可以睡沙发。再说,昨晚我连一分钟觉都没睡,现在睡哪都行。

lines.en: I’ll just...leave her alone.
lines.zh: : 我就……让她一个人静一静。

lines.en: I can do that, right?
lines.zh: : 我能做到的,对吧?

lines.en: : Yikes...
lines.zh: : 好家伙……

lines.en: : Yeah. Turns out girls don’t like it very much when you have sex with their sister instead of them.
lines.zh: : 是啊。事实证明,女孩们不太喜欢你跟她们的姐姐做,而不是跟她们做。

lines.en: scene amiridehome12
: I mean, I also don’t like that you had sex with Noriko. But you don’t see me avoiding you because of it. Maybe Aunt Niki’s just in a bad mood today?
lines.zh: : 我是说,你和 Noriko 做这事我也不喜欢。但你看我没有因此躲着你。也许 Niki 姨只是今天心情不好?

lines.en: : Shut up, Ami. Just...please shut up.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴,Ami。求你……闭嘴。

lines.en: : Wow. Maybe you’re in a bad mood too, Dad.
lines.zh: : 哇。也许你心情也不好,爸爸。

lines.en: : Hahah...hah...I, uhh...
scene amiridehome13
: I should probably go. I imagine you guys, uhh...want some space today.
lines.zh: : 我该走了。我猜你们,呃……今天需要空间。

lines.en: : But, uhh...call me? Is it...weird for me to say that now? I am in a...rather unique and new situation all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 不过,呃……给我打电话?我现在说这话会不会很怪?我突然处于一个……相当独特又全新的处境里。

lines.en: : Later, Noriko. Thanks for fucking my dad and teaching me how to play Karuta.
lines.zh: : 回头见,Noriko。谢谢你干了我爸,还教我玩歌牌。

lines.en: scene amiridehome14
: Chk, chk! Any time, sis!
lines.zh: : 喳喳!随时效劳,姐们!

lines.en: : Okay. Tone it down, please.
lines.zh: : 好。请收敛一点。

lines.en: scene amiridehome15
: I am so sorry you had to see that.
lines.zh: : 真抱歉让你看到了那一幕。

lines.en: : It’s okay! Bye, Noriko!
lines.zh: : 没关系!拜拜,Noriko!

lines.en: : Bye, Ami! Bye, Nii-chan! Thanks for...all the sex!
lines.zh: : 拜拜,Ami!拜拜,Nii-chan!谢谢你们……做的那些事!

lines.en: : GYAAAAAAAH! WHAT AM I DOING?! BE NORMAL, NORIKO! JUST BE NORMAL!
lines.zh: : 呀啊啊啊啊!我在干什么?!正常点,NORIKO!正常一点!

lines.en: : Hahah! Oh, Noriko. Look at how happy she is now that she’s finally gotten what she-
lines.zh: : 哈哈!哦,Noriko。看看她,终于得到想要的以后多开——

lines.en: : Ami. A word, please? In private.
lines.zh: : Ami。借一步说话,可以吗?私下。

lines.en: scene amiridehome16
: But we’re already in private, Dad. This is our house. It’s the only the place in the world where the two of us can-
lines.zh: : 可我们已经「私下」了呀,爸爸。这是我们的家。这里是全世界唯一一个我们俩可以——

lines.en: : In your room. Now.
lines.zh: : 去你房间。现在。

lines.en: : My room? But-
lines.zh: : 我的房间?可是——

lines.en: : Ami...now.
lines.zh: : Ami……现在。

lines.en: scene black
: Jeez, Dad. All you had to do was say “please.” You know I can’t say no to you when you do that.
lines.zh: : 天哪,爸爸。你只要说声「请」就行。你知道你一那样说,我就没法拒绝。

lines.en: scene amiridehome17
: Not like I’d ever want to anyway, though. You always know what’s best for me after all! And I mean, of course that’s the case given how long we-
lines.zh: : 反正我也从来不想拒绝。你总是知道什么对我最好!我是说,考虑到我们相识这么久,这当然是理所当然——

lines.en: : Did you help Niki come find us last night?
lines.zh: : 是你昨晚帮 Niki 找到我们的吗?

lines.en: scene amiridehome18
: Hm? Yeah.
lines.zh: : 嗯?对。

lines.en: : Ami-
lines.zh: : Ami——

lines.en: : But she’s the one who figured out you were there. And I can imagine you saw it coming since I’m clearly not the type to engage in lesbian sex with anyone.
lines.zh: : 但发现你的人在的是她。我猜你也料到了,因为我显然不是会跟任何人搞女女性爱的那种人。

lines.en: : It was a terrible lie. But I saw it through to the end for your sake, Dad. I could only hold her off for so long.
lines.zh: : 那是个烂到家的谎话。但为了你,我把它演完了,爸爸。我也只能拖住她那么久。

lines.en: : But you helped her...You knew I was alone with Noriko, and you helped Niki find us.
lines.zh: : 可是你帮了她……你知道我和 Noriko 单独在一起,你还帮 Niki 找到我们。

lines.en: : ...Right. But how was I supposed to know you two were having sex? Wasn’t that the first time?
lines.zh: : ……对。可我怎么知道你们俩在做那种事?那不是第一次吗?

lines.en: : Ami-
lines.zh: : Ami——

lines.en: : Sorry, why am I somehow in trouble for you having sex with your girlfriend’s little sister? Is this some kind of roleplay thing? Did you put your dad-pants on this morning?
lines.zh: : 抱歉,为什么受罚的莫名其妙是我?你和女友的妹妹上床,现在怪到我头上?这是什么新的角色扮演吗?你今早穿上「爸爸裤」了?

lines.en: : Why are you not upset?...You see how much she’s hurting, don’t you? Do you have any idea what this means for me and her? Don’t you like her?
lines.zh: : 你为什么一点都不难过?……你看得见她有多痛苦,对吧?你知道这意味着什么吗——对我和她?你不喜欢她吗?

lines.en: scene amiridehome19
: Of course I like her, Dad! Aunt Niki’s done so much for both of us. I love her with all of my heart.
lines.zh: : 我当然喜欢她,爸爸!Niki 姨为我们俩做了那么多。我全心全意地爱她。

lines.en: : But at the same time, don’t you guys think you might be overreacting a little bit? Like, is it really so bad that she just saw you being yourself? She was gonna find out eventually.
lines.zh: : 但与此同时,你们不觉得你们可能有点反应过度了吗?她只是看到了你做自己的样子,真的有那么糟吗?她反正迟早会知道。

lines.en: : Yes, eventually. Organically. Not at the behest of my jealous daughter and her need to always be involved in every facet of my life.
lines.zh: : 对,迟早。顺其自然地知道。而不是在我那个嫉妒的女儿的授意下——她非要插手我生活的每一个角落。

lines.en: scene amiridehome20
if amifingered == True:
: You seem quite mad at me, Father. Perhaps a blowjob is in order?
lines.zh: : 你好像很生我的气呢,父亲大人。要不我来个口交赔罪?

lines.en: : No, Ami. I don’t want a fucking blowjob. I want you to stay out of my private affairs and-
lines.zh: : 不,Ami。我不想要什么该死的口交。我要你离我的私事远一点,而且——

lines.en: else:
: You seem quite mad at me, Father. Come closer. I will hug you until you’re feeling better.
lines.zh: : 你好像很生我的气呢,父亲大人。过来一点。我会抱你,抱到你好起来为止。

lines.en: : I don’t want a fucking hug, Ami. I want you to stay out of my private affairs and-
lines.zh: : 我不想要什么该死的拥抱,Ami。我要你离我的私事远一点,而且——

lines.en: : And what? Let you torpedo your life all on your own? Got it. It’s not my fault you fucked Noriko and broke Niki’s heart. Don’t blame me for that.
lines.zh: : 而且什么?任由你独自把人生搞沉?明白了。你干了 Noriko、伤了 Niki 的心,可不是我的错。别把锅甩给我。

lines.en: : You helped her! And I don’t know what you two were talking about before you found us, but something tells me it wasn’t exactly wholesome.
lines.zh: : 是你帮了她!而且在你们找到我们之前我不知道你们俩聊了什么,但我敢肯定绝非什么正经内容。

lines.en: scene amiridehome21
: It was very wholesome, actually. Aunt Niki and I had a really long heart-to-heart in the bath about how much we love you and how we’re both so desperate to make you happy.
lines.zh: : 其实正经得很。Niki 姨和我在浴缸里进行了一场超长的交心,聊我们有多爱你、我们俩有多拼命想让你幸福。

lines.en: : I even got to talk about my mom.
lines.zh: : 我甚至还聊到了我妈。

lines.en: : And for a second, it almost felt like she was there with us, giving Niki her blessing while patting me on the head and thanking me for taking such good care of you.
lines.zh: : 有那么一瞬间,真的感觉她就在我们身边——一边抚摸我的头、感谢我把你照顾得这么好,一边祝福 Niki。

lines.en: scene amiridehome22
: Which...makes it so much sadder that Aunt Niki’s going to move out now. I was just starting to really like having her around too. This trip was a turning point for us I think. And now that she’s-
lines.zh: : 所以……Niki 姨现在要搬走,才显得那么让人难过。我刚开始真心喜欢有她在的日子。我觉得这趟旅行是我们的转折点。而现在她——

lines.en: : Niki isn’t moving out.
lines.zh: : Niki 不会搬走。

lines.en: scene amiridehome23
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: scene amiridehome24
: What do you mean she isn’t moving out?
lines.zh: : 「不搬走」是什么意思?

lines.en: : I mean she’s going to stay here. We’re just...not going to be spending much time together.
lines.zh: : 意思是她会留下来。我们只是……不会再有多少相处时间。

lines.en: : Then...why is she staying here?
lines.zh: : 那……她为什么还要留在这里?

lines.en: : Convenience? Maybe for you?
lines.zh: : 图方便?也许是为了你?

lines.en: : For me.
lines.zh: : 为了我。

lines.en: : Maybe. She didn’t give me a reason. I thought she was moving out too. But she told me she was going to stay.
lines.zh: : 也许。她没给我理由。我原以为她也要搬走的。但她告诉我她会留下。
: 所以……

lines.en: : You fuck her little sister right in front of her...for five hours...
lines.zh: : 你当着她的面……干了她的妹妹……整整五个小时……

lines.en: : And she’s still going to live with us?
lines.zh: : 而她还是要跟我们住在一起?

lines.en: : That’s right...she’s not leaving just yet.
lines.zh: : 没错……她暂时不会走。

lines.en: : Is she a fucking idiot?
lines.zh: : 她是不是脑子有病?

lines.en: : Ami...that’s-
lines.zh: : Ami……这——

lines.en: scene amiridehome25
: You FUCK her little sister...
lines.zh: : 你干了她的妹妹……

lines.en: scene amiridehome26
: For FIVE fucking hours...
lines.zh: : 整整五个该死的小时……

lines.en: : And you’re telling me that she’s just going to stay.
lines.zh: : 然后你告诉我,她只是打算继续住下。

lines.en: : Is there a problem with that, Ami?
lines.zh: : 这有什么问题吗,Ami?

lines.en: scene amiridehome27
: Oh, no! Not at all, Dad!
lines.zh: : 哦,没有!完全没有,爸爸!

lines.en: : In fact, I think it’s great living under the same roof as someone so open-minded! It makes me so extremely curious about which one of my classmates you’re going to fuck in front of her next!
lines.zh: : 事实上,我觉得和一个如此思想开放的人住在一个屋檐下,太棒了!这让我无比好奇:下一个在她面前被你干的同班同学,会是哪一位!

lines.en: : Boy, I sure do hope it’s me!
lines.zh: : 哎呀,我真的很希望是我!

lines.en: scene black
scene amiridehome28
: So that’s why you were smiling all morning...You thought she was leaving.
lines.zh: : 所以你整个上午都在笑……你以为她要走了。

lines.en: : Oh, forgive me for wanting my life back! You’re the one who invited her here! Not me!
lines.zh: : 哦,原谅我只是想拿回我的人生!是她自己非要搬来的!不是我!

lines.en: : You were smiling when you interrupted Maya and me the other night as well.
lines.zh: : 那天晚上你打断我和 Maya 的时候,你也在笑。

lines.en: : Mhm! I did offer to watch, though. So it’s not like I’m evil, is it?
lines.zh: : 没错!但我可是主动提出可以观摩的。所以我也算不上坏,对吧?

lines.en: scene amiridehome29
: Is it?...
I look down at her, but I do not see my daughter.
lines.zh: 我低头看她,但我看到的不是我的女儿。

lines.en: I see someone who looks like her...talks like her...smells like her...but my daughter wishes for nothing but my happiness.
lines.zh: 我看到一个长得像她……说话像她……气味像她……的人;而我的女儿,唯一的心愿只是我的幸福。

lines.en: And this girl wants to hurt me.
lines.zh: : 而这个女孩,想伤害我。

lines.en: : You have no idea how much I do for you...do you, Dad?
lines.zh: : 你根本不知道我为你付出了多少……是吧,爸爸?

lines.en: : You’ve always done everything for me, Ami...but that doesn’t give you the right to toy with the people I love and-
lines.zh: : 你一直在为我做一切,Ami……但这不等于你有权玩弄我爱的人,而且——

lines.en: : Oh, no. No, no, no. I’m not talking about cooking...or cleaning...or filing your fucking taxes. I am talking about everything else. The things I do that you don’t see.
lines.zh: : 哦,不。不,不,不。我说的不是做饭……不是打扫……不是替你填那些该死的税表。我说的是其他一切。那些你看不见的、我在做的事。

lines.en: : Well, then how the fuck would I know about them, Ami?
lines.zh: : 那我他妈的怎么可能知道,Ami?

lines.en: scene amiridehome30
: YOU WOULDN’T! THAT’S THE FUCKING POINT!
lines.zh: : 你当然不会知道!这就是重点!

lines.en: : So when I ask you if you have any idea how much I do for you, the answer is obviously no! “No, Ami! I don’t know what you do! But thank you! I love you! Yours truly, Father!”
lines.zh: : 所以当我问你「你知不知道我付出了多少」,答案显然是不知道!「不知道哦,Ami!我不知道你在做什么!但是谢谢!我爱你!爱你的父亲敬上!」

lines.en: : Fine! Sure! But either way, the fact that you’re running around and praying for the downfall of the people I love-
lines.zh: : 行!好!但无论如何,你到处蹦跶、巴不得我爱的人统统完蛋——

lines.en: : Don’t fucking talk to me about praying, Dad! Not even as a figure of speech! I will not lose you to some fucking worthless God as well!
lines.zh: : 别他妈跟我提「祈祷」,爸爸!连当个比喻都不行!我绝不会让你也被那个一文不值的神抢走!

lines.en: scene amiridehome31
: What the fuck is that supposed to mean?! Who else have you lost to-
lines.zh: : 你这话什么意思?!你还被抢走过谁——

lines.en: scene amiridehome32
: YOU KNOW EXACTLY WHO I LOST!
lines.zh: : 你明知道我失去了谁!

lines.en: : YOU SAW WHAT WAS HAPPENING TO HER AND YOU IGNORED IT! YOU WERE THE ONLY ONE SHE TRUSTED AND YOU DIDN’T FUCKING LISTEN! YOU LET IT CONSUME HER!
lines.zh: : 你眼睁睁看着发生在她身上的事,却视而不见!她唯一信任的人是你,你他妈根本不听!你放任它吞噬了她!

lines.en: scene hydrangeafield2
scene imissyoumore
scene amiridehome33
: POEM AFTER POEM AFTER POEM! VOICES, VOICES, VOICES! IT’S NO WONDER SHE COULDN’T BREATHE WITH A NOOSE LIKE THAT AROUND HER NECK!!
lines.zh: : 一首诗,又一首诗,再一首诗!声音,声音,声音!难怪她喘不过气——脖子上勒着那样一圈绞索!!

lines.en: : Your mom...died in an accident, Ami...
lines.zh: : 你妈妈……死于意外,Ami……

lines.en: : She didn’t-
lines.zh: : 她不是——

lines.en: scene amiridehome34
: I know how she fucking died! But she was practically dead for a whole fucking year before that while her mind was being overrun by who the fuck knows what!
lines.zh: : 我知道她他妈是怎么死的!但在那之前,整整一年,她就已经形同死人——脑子不知道被什么东西占据了!

lines.en: : And you could have done something! You could have listened! Because I know you read the poems! But you didn’t understand them! You didn’t believe them! No one did!
lines.zh: : 你本可以做点什么的!你本可以听的!因为我知道你读过那些诗!可你看不懂!你不信!谁都不信!

lines.en: scene amiridehome35
: And I...how am I supposed to think you’ll believe me then?
lines.zh: : 而我……那我又凭什么相信,你会相信我?

lines.en: : I don’t blame you for the fact that she’s gone. I just...when I think about how scared she must have been that last year...I can’t take it...
lines.zh: : 她走了,我不怪你。我只是……一想到她最后那一年有多害怕……我就受不了……

lines.en: : I can’t take it...
lines.zh: : 我受不了……

lines.en: scene yourname
scene smileex
scene anormaldoor
scene amiridehome36
: AAAAAAAAHHHHH! I CAN’T TAKE IT! IT HURTS TOO MUCH!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊!我受不了!太痛了!

lines.en: scene amiridehome37
: AND NOW YOU HATE ME TOO?! I HAVE NO HAIR LEFT TO CUT OFF! I WAS ONLY DOING WHAT I HAD TO!
lines.zh: : 现在你也恨我了?!我的头发已经剪得一根不剩!我做的全是我不得不做的!

lines.en: : So what?...You had to get Niki out of the house?
lines.zh: : 所以呢?……你就必须把 Niki 赶出家门?

lines.en: : Will that bring your mom back, Ami? Is that what you want?
lines.zh: : 那样你妈妈就会回来吗,Ami?那是你想要的吗?

lines.en: scene amiridehome38
: Don’t fucking talk to me like that...
lines.zh: : 别用那种口气跟我说话……

lines.en: scene amiridehome39
: I will NOT let you TALK to me like THAT! Not with everything I have to endure for YOUR SAKE!
lines.zh: : 我绝不允许你用那种口气跟我说话!我为你忍受了那么多!

lines.en: : Ami...
lines.zh: : Ami……

lines.en: scene amiridehome40
: What happened to you?...
lines.zh: : 你怎么了?……

lines.en: : What HAPPENED to me?!
lines.zh: : 「我怎么了」?!

lines.en: scene amiridehome41
: YOU DID! YOU happened to me! I’m like this because of YOU!
lines.zh: : 是你!是你把我变成这样的!我之所以是现在这样,全是因为你!

lines.en: scene amiridehome42
: And you fucking KNOW it because it’s the only GOD DAMN FUCKING REASON you will let me call you “Dad” now!
lines.zh: : 而你他妈心知肚明——因为这是如今你肯让我叫你「爸爸」的唯一该死理由!

lines.en: : Do you have ANY idea how fucking HARD it is for a seven year old to raise TWO PEOPLE when you’re in your fucking THIRTIES and can’t even raise YOURSELF?!
lines.zh: : 你有「任何」概念吗——一个七岁的孩子要养「两个人」,而你自己都三十好几了、连自己都养不明白?!

lines.en: : But now I’M the bad guy because you lost something you never deserved and need someone to BLAME?! I DID NOTHING!
lines.zh: : 结果现在「我」成了坏人,就因为你失去了你从来配不上的东西、急需一个怪罪的对象?!我什么都没做!

lines.en: : You wanted her gone...
lines.zh: : 你是想让她走……

lines.en: : YOU’RE DAMN FUCKING RIGHT I DID!
lines.zh: : 你他妈说得太对了,我就是想!

lines.en: : BECAUSE DESPITE ALL OF THAT! DESPITE THE PAIN AND TORTURE AND NEVER KNOWING IF YOU WILL EVER TRULY UNDERSTAND THE SHEER GRAVITY OF WHAT I DO FOR YOU...
lines.zh: : 因为,尽管有这一切!尽管那些痛苦与折磨、尽管我永远不知道你能否真正理解我为你做的一切有多沉重……

lines.en: : DESPITE KNOWING THAT THE LAST YEAR OF MY MOM’S LIFE IS THE ONE THING YOU’LL NEVER STOP SUPPRESSING...
lines.zh: : 尽管我知道,我妈生命的最后一年,是你永远、永远不愿提起的东西……

lines.en: scene amiridehome43
: Despite all of that...
lines.zh: : 尽管有这一切……

lines.en: : I have never stopped living for you.
lines.zh: : 我从未停止为你而活。

lines.en: : The one thing I have left.
lines.zh: : 那是我仅剩的一样东西。

lines.en: : But sometimes?...
lines.zh: : 可有时候?……

lines.en: : I feel like you’d be happier if I died too.
lines.zh: : 我觉得,要是我也死了,你会更幸福。

lines.en: : And there’s only one way to find out if that’s true or not.
lines.zh: : 而只有一种办法,可以验证这是不是真的。

lines.en: : Ami-
lines.zh: : Ami——

lines.en: : Don’t follow me.
lines.zh: : 别跟着我。

lines.en: : I want to be alone.
lines.zh: : 我想一个人待着。

lines.en: scene amiridehome44
: Can you at least tell me where you’re going?
lines.zh: : 你至少能告诉我要去哪吗?

lines.en: : Somewhere I won’t be a fucking burden anymore!
lines.zh: : 去一个我再也不是他妈的累赘的地方!

lines.en: : Ami-
lines.zh: : Ami——

lines.en: scene amiridehome45
I kept thinking to myself — as I stood there in a room a little girl decorated without my help — that there was no way Niki could hear all of this and not come in to tell me things will be okay.
lines.zh: : 我一直站在原地反复想着——在一个小女孩独自布置、没要我一滴帮忙的房间里——Niki 听完这些,不可能不冲进来说一切都会好起来。

lines.en: But she didn’t.
lines.zh: : 但她没有。

lines.en: So I stood there for the next half hour, wondering how to make love stay. But there was nothing I came up with that didn’t immediately make things worse.
lines.zh: : 于是我在原地站了半个多小时,想着怎么留住爱。而我想到的每一个办法,都会立刻把事情弄得更糟。

lines.en: Now she’s gone. And Ami’s gone. And not even the ghost is here to poke fun at how badly I’ve fucked everything up this time.
lines.zh: : 现在她走了。Ami 也走了。连那个幽灵都不在,没人来嘲笑我这次把一切搞砸得有多彻底。

lines.en: And sure, there are places for me to go...
lines.zh: : 当然,我有地方可去……

lines.en: Other people who’d be happy to help me right now...
lines.zh: : 有很多人此刻巴不得帮我……

lines.en: But I’m too scared to call them.
lines.zh: : 但我不敢给他们打电话。

lines.en: I just miss my daughter.
lines.zh: : 我只是想我的女儿了。

lines.en: I miss my childhood friend.
lines.zh: : 我想我的青梅竹马了。

lines.en: And I’ve only been alone for thirty minutes.
lines.zh: : 而我才孤独了三十分钟。

lines.en: scene black
I lie down in Ami’s bed. And when I close my eyes, I can almost trick myself into believing she’s still here.
lines.zh: : 我躺进 Ami 的床。闭上眼,我几乎能骗过自己:她还在这里。

lines.en: But despite having stayed awake all night, I’m unable to fall asleep. I feel like I don’t deserve this bed.
lines.zh: : 但即便熬了一整夜没合眼,我还是睡不着。我觉得我不配这张床。

lines.en: Or her.
lines.zh: : 不配她。

lines.en: Or any of this.
lines.zh: : 不配这一切。

lines.en: But there is a closet-
lines.zh: : 但有一个壁橱——

lines.en: Propped open by a school bag with a notebook sticking out.
lines.zh: : 被一个塞着笔记本的书包支开着。

lines.en: And for some reason-
lines.zh: : 而不知为何——

lines.en: I think I’ll be able to sleep in there.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我可以在那里睡着。
